verdict.rationale: Loops documents an official hosted remote MCP server at https://mcp.loops.so, with a dedicated docs page and a ready-made `claude mcp add --transport http` command. It lists the tool scope: contacts, mailing lists, transactional email, events, and the rest of the API. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and documentation of MCP-specific auth and setup for clients other than Claude.
